integration_policy: Original compatibility metadata and adapter logic. Prefer the installed upstream example workflow and live ComfyUI schemas. Do not bundle or relicense upstream code, LoRA weights, or model components.
major_capabilities: MiniMax H3 joint video+audio generation in a 4-step starting profile
separate video/audio flow schedules in the custom sampler
full and pruned/curve MiniMax H3 base support
text-to-video and image-to-video compatibility with the official H3 graph structure

turbo_lora.low_vram_off: runtime bypass; sharper; more peak VRAM
turbo_lora.low_vram_on: merge into weights; lower peak VRAM; can be softer on quantized bases

workflow_rules: Start from the current official H3 T2V/I2V workflow or the installed Turbo example workflow.
Insert MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA in the MODEL path after the H3 diffusion loader and before the guider/sampling path.
Use BasicScheduler scheduler=simple with 4 steps as the starting profile; upstream documents values >=4 as valid.
Preserve H3 conditioning, joint AV latent handling, video/audio VAE decode, and CreateVideo muxing unless the task explicitly changes them.
Do not substitute a stock single-schedule sampler at 4 steps and claim audio is validated.
Use live /object_info schemas and the installed example workflow before editing node widgets or connections.

common_failures.broken_audio_at_4_steps: Check that MiniMaxH3TurboSampler, not a stock sampler, feeds SamplerCustomAdvanced.
common_failures.smear_or_ghosting: Consider increasing LoRA strength slightly from 1.0 and validate the result.
common_failures.oversharp_grain: Consider reducing LoRA strength below 1.0 and validate the result.
common_failures.oom: Enable low_vram and/or lower resolution or frame count; low_vram may soften quantized-base output.
common_failures.wrong_latent: The Turbo sampler expects the MiniMax H3 joint video+audio latent from EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV or MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.

runtime_authority: Live ComfyUI node schemas and the installed upstream example workflow override this static knowledge when versions differ.
